name: netsapiens-mcp
description: Every NetSapiens v2 endpoint plus a reseller-wide fleet view: seat limits, offline phones, unrouted numbers and E911 gaps across every client at once.

netsapiens_api_key.title: NETSAPIENS_API_KEY
netsapiens_api_key.description: Sets NETSAPIENS_API_KEY for the NetSapiens MCP server.

netsapiens_server.title: NETSAPIENS_SERVER
netsapiens_server.description: Your NetSapiens platform host, for example pbx.yourprovider.example (ns-api.com is only the public sandbox).

netsapiens_base_url.title: NetSapiens API base URL (optional)
netsapiens_base_url.description: Optional. Overrides the whole base URL (https://<host>/ns-api/v2) when your provider uses a different path. Leave blank to build it from the platform host.

printing_press_client_profile.title: Client profile (optional)
printing_press_client_profile.description: Only for tenant-gated multi-client deployments: binds the MCP server to an existing Printing Press client profile. Leave blank for a single-tenant install.

netsapiens_mcp_read_only.title: Read-only MCP mode
netsapiens_mcp_read_only.description: Optional. Set to exactly 1 to expose only read-only tools and refuse any state-changing execute call. Leave blank to keep every tool available.

netsapiens_no_local_data.title: Run without a local copy
netsapiens_no_local_data.description: Optional. Set to 1 to keep no local copy of API responses: reads go to the API and the response cache is off. Leave blank to keep the local store.

netsapiens_mcp_http_token.title: MCP HTTP transport bearer token
netsapiens_mcp_http_token.description: Required only when running the MCP server with --transport http (a remote/hosted deployment). Callers must send a matching Authorization: Bearer header. Not needed for the default local stdio transport that Claude Desktop uses.

netsapiens_user_agent.title: User-Agent header
netsapiens_user_agent.description: Overrides the User-Agent the CLI sends on NetSapiens requests. Leave blank to use the CLI's own built-in User-Agent.

netsapiens_mcp_upload_root.title: MCP upload folder (optional)
netsapiens_mcp_upload_root.description: Optional. Leave blank. Reserved for MCP file uploads: no NetSapiens MCP tool in this release takes a file, so the server never opens a local path and this setting has no effect.
